item.title: In photos: Shams Tabrizi mausoleum complex officially opened in Khoy
item.description: The mausoleum complex of Shams Tabrizi was officially inaugurated on Wednesday evening, October 7, 2026, in the northwestern County of Khoy. The event was attended by Reza Salehi-Amiri, the Minister of Cultural Heritage, Tourism, and Handicrafts, along with several Iranian and foreign officials.
